text:
Jake Guentzel has ten points in his last five games, including four assists against Buffalo and the go-ahead goal in Columbus on Thursday in what Reuters called a milestone game. He's at 24 points in 19 for a Lightning team that has won five of six while the Kucherov trade saga hangs over everything.

Guentzel is getting a bit of help. He's shooting 21% against 17% last season, with 11 goals on 8.1 expected, and Tampa has scored 9.9 more goals than expected with him on the ice. His 3.62 points per 60 is above the 3.14 our talent range sees as his true level. The Lightning are also leaning on him more: nearly 22 minutes a night over his last ten, up almost two minutes.

The underlying play is good, though. Tampa owns 62% of the five-on-five expected goals with him out there. Evolving-Hockey's caveat is that he's long played with excellent teammates, which flatters his on-ice numbers. That's the thing to watch. If Kucherov is moved, Guentzel's line becomes the measure of how much of this was him.
headline: Guentzel is scoring like a top-line winger
